messages:
Leah (partners_pm): quick sync 1: could we run a 3-day SI onboarding sprint next Tue-Thu. Focus: marketplace listing checklist, voucher handoff, and a short cert smoke test. Need owners for sandbox creds, lab script, cert, and announcement copy.
Tom (partner_eng): I can own sandbox creds. recommend ephemeral tokens TTL=72h and quota 120k tokens/day.
Nina (partner_ops): vouchers: we have 2 remaining for Q2. I'll reserve one per SI if you confirm names by Fri. Also made a basic enrollment form.
Omar (enablement): cert smoke test idea: 20-min practical (deploy + smoke call) + 10 MCQs. pass=75%. keep it light.
Leah (partners_pm): sounds good. Tom, can you post a sample access YAML when ready? Nina, I'll DM names. Omar, please draft the MCQs.
Tom (partner_eng): sample YAML posted to the repo: github.com/redwood/partner-onboard/sample-access.yml. Includes token endpoint and allowlist note.
announce-bot: reminder  create marketplace draft in /marketing/partner-templates by 3612350000
Nina (partner_ops): enrollment form link posted: https://go.redwood/forms/si-onboard. Added voucher opt-in.
Omar (enablement): MCQ draft uploaded to the enablement drive. Also suggest a 30-min "office hours" slot on day2 for troubleshooting.
Leah (partners_pm): thanks everyone. I'll make a short announcement once voucher recipients confirmed. Meeting Fri 09:30 to finalize assets. :white_check_mark:
